# 12CAD.com

> A comprehensive Computer Aided Design learning platform offering tutorials, exercises, and resources for beginners and professionals.

12CAD.com provides structured CAD education through practice-oriented tutorials, downloadable exercises, and curated resources for AutoCAD, Draftsight, and other design software. The platform serves as a knowledge hub for CAD learners at all levels, from complete beginners to experienced professionals seeking to expand their skillset.

## Key Topics

- CAD (Computer-Aided Design)
- AutoCAD
- Draftsight
- DWG
- 3D Design
- 2D Design
- CAD Exercises
- CAD Software
- Beginner Guide
- Tutorials
- CAD Resources
- AutoDesk
- Catia
- Design Workflow
- Hardware for CAD

## Getting Started with CAD

- [Getting Started with CAD - 12CAD.com](https://www.computeraideddesignguide.com/getting-started-with-cad): Beginner guide for CAD learning covering AutoCAD and SolidWorks basics
- [100 CAD Exercises - Beginners Guide - 12CAD.com](https://www.computeraideddesignguide.com/100-cad-exercises-beginners-guide): Comprehensive beginner's guide with 100 CAD exercises and practice drills
- [Free Download: 5 CAD Exercises - 12CAD.com](https://www.computeraideddesignguide.com/free-download-5-cad-exercises): Free downloadable CAD exercises for beginners with 2D/3D practice drills
- [CAD resources](https://www.computeraideddesignguide.com/resources): Curated list of free and paid CAD resources for beginners

## AutoCAD Tutorials & Exercises

- [AutoCAD Tutorial](https://www.computeraideddesignguide.com/autocad-tutorial): Practice-oriented AutoCAD tutorials with exercises for 2D/3D design
